releaseNotes: Eclipse Companion 1.0.13: fixes the Android APK installer hand-off and adds a direct GitHub APK download; introduces Light and Dark modes plus ten extra colour themes; refreshes the language selector; adds live local cloud cover, temperature, humidity and wind readings with offline cache; adds a private offline photo album stored on-device; adds an Android home-screen countdown widget; expands local notifications to include Luxor eclipse phase milestones; retains the trip planner, offline essentials, GPS viewing finder, safety guide, emergency help, Egypt attractions, journal, achievements and solar-system explorer. Removes bundled obsolete APKs to reduce installer size.
